_comment: Bookshelf trigger placements for SCENE 2. s = metres along the chase path where the shelf stands. mode: 'jump' (falls flat, low barrier) or 'slide' (lands leaning, gap underneath). offset = metres left(-)/right(+) of the path centreline where the shelf starts (which wall it falls from). The shelf begins toppling when the player is CONFIG.chase.shelfTriggerLead metres away.
